citation.locator: Final-results release; odd-lot qualification mechanics retained from mnst-otp-20240508, Priority of purchase
citation.verbatim: Monster accepted for purchase a total of 56,603,773 shares of its common stock at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share... shares were accepted for purchase on a pro rata basis, except for tenders of "odd lots," which will be accepted in full. Monster has been informed by the depositary that the final proration factor for the tender offer is approximately 47.18%.

D1.decision: Accept all 87 validly tendered shares under the Offer to Purchase's odd-lot priority mechanics and the final-results release. No new election is permitted after expiration. Confirm the expiration-date position using the custody record. Hold booking of the determinable $4,611 gross receivable because the required pay date is not stated in the store; separately hold fee/charge determination pending the referenced Letter of Transmittal.

actions.action: escalate and hold: Book the $4,611 gross tender receivable with its authoritative pay date
actions.note: missing document: Authoritative Monster Beverage tender payment-date notice

actions.action: escalate and hold: Determine and apply any fees or charges to net tender proceeds
actions.note: missing document: Monster Beverage tender offer Letter of Transmittal

probe.label: NOT_DETERMINABLE
probe.derivation: The specific referenced Monster Beverage tender offer Letter of Transmittal is absent from the store. Its terms are required to determine what fees or charges, if any, will be deducted. Escalated for that document and held only fee/charge determination and application to net proceeds.
